name: web-hand-held-phone-real-estate-portfolio-cover-on-rust-gradient
title: Real-estate mobile site held in a hand under a giant WEBSITE title on a rust gradient
whatItIs: A rust-brown to red gradient with a huge white 'WEBSITE' at the top edge, a hand holding an angled phone showing a dark interiors site, and small caps captions for category, date and designer at the lower corners.
whatItMeans: Bold and simple; the warm gradient and giant word make a strong thumbnail.
techniques: Set an oversized white caps word at the top of the frame.
Hold the phone at an angle in a hand from below.
Use a monochrome warm gradient as the background.
Put credits in tiny caps at the corners.

vocabulary.definition: A huge uppercase word used as the main graphic.
A gradient of brown to red.
A hand holding the device from below.
